# `core/memory/PipelineCache.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/PipelineCache.js`

PipelineCache.js - Async Pipeline Compilation & Caching Eliminates frame hitches by compiling all pipelines asynchronously at startup. Caches pipelines for instant retrieval during rendering. Benefits: - No frame drops during shader compilation - All shaders ready before first frame - Easy pipeline management Usage: await pipelineCache.warmup(device, [ { name: 'terrain', descriptor: terrainDesc }, { name: 'water', descriptor: waterDesc }, ]); const pipeline = pipelineCache.getRender('terrain');
